context.claim_limits: Forecast CHDD uses nine predicted economic outputs and observed history only. It includes all official economic terms, but it is not physically verified CHDD. No independently certified uncertainty, deployment approval or guaranteed uplift. Supplied schedule restrictions remain mandatory; unsupported forecast operating limits stop this mode.

constraints.before_first_source_control: Must remain SHUT with zero rate; well_updates must not open wells earlier.

water_balance_semantics.max_monthly_voidage_replacement: Upper bound on monthly injected/produced reservoir volumes; positive injection with zero withdrawal violates this bound.
water_balance_semantics.max_monthly_water_deficit_m3: Cap max(0, injected minus produced surface water volume) per month and explicit well group; excludes storage/processing losses.
water_balance_semantics.min_monthly_voidage_replacement: Lower bound on monthly injected/produced reservoir volumes for the explicit well group.
water_balance_semantics.verification: Requires actual OPM cumulative volume differences; predicted oil/liquid/pressure alone cannot certify these limits.

constraints.water_limits_source: Read operating_constraints. An absent bound is unspecified; it is not proof of unlimited water availability.

conversion_search.instruction: Assess producer-to-injector conversions across the full eligible producer inventory using only pre-origin state, geology and official conversion costs. For a producer_to_injector search, propose at least one new permanent conversion as a hypothesis for full OPM; include explicit WRAT, rate, start date and injection BHP ceiling. Keep other controls unchanged to isolate its effect. Do not claim gain or surrogate accuracy for new roles before physical validation. Reverse conversion is forbidden.

norms_rows: Прочие ДиР, не включаемые в EBITDA

forecast_detail.scope: Forecast detail for analysis; every complete candidate forecast remains in its persisted artifact.

geology.limitations: Static connectivity prior, not a dynamic flow model: shortest paths omit parallel-path effective conductance; coincident completions use the minimum positive grid-edge resistance floor, not measured wellbore resistance; phase mobilities and threshold-pressure activation require OPM.

context.objective: Improve forecast CHDD over all 224 months using permitted rates, BHP, statuses and producer-to-injector conversions. Call propose_policy exactly once with an unexplored policy. The official calculator scores forecasts, including pumps, conversions, water costs, taxes and discounting. All search evaluations use TimesFM; only the graph with maximum eligible forecast CHDD is sealed for one final OPM check. Never ask for OPM to compare search alternatives.

pressure_semantics.control_bhp_limit: Planned lower producer / upper injector BHP bound; not the forecast target.
pressure_semantics.forecast_definition: WBP9 nine-point block pressure; not wellhead pressure
pressure_semantics.inactive_zero: A zero WBP9 report for an inactive well is not evidence of zero physical reservoir pressure.

surrogate_evidence.interpretation: Checkpoint loading and forecast execution are verified. Accuracy certification is a separate, unresolved property; it does not mean the model is untrained. The unchanged baseline is already evaluated.

decisions.summary: Состояние инициализировано: загружен чекпоинт TimesFM, baseline (id=0) рассчитан и сериализован. Ограничения по воде и BHP заданы. Следующий шаг — генерация первой гипотезы политики (producer_scale) для проверки на суррогате.
evidence: constraints.operating_constraints: [] (нет явных запретов на изменение producer_scale)

decisions.summary: Анализ 8 кандидатов показывает, что увеличение producer_scale (id=1, 5, 6) и injector_scale (id=3) повышает прогнозируемый ЧДД по сравнению с baseline (id=0). Максимальный ЧДД (12505.33 млн руб) достигнут при injector_scale=1.2 (id=3). Снижение producer_scale (id=4) или injector_scale (id=2) ухудшает результат. Связи скважин (geology) подтверждают наличие активных кластеров, где увеличение закачки может быть эффективно. Ограничения по воде отсутствуют (operating_constraints: []), что позволяет тестировать увеличение закачки. Следующий шаг — предложить политику с injector_scale=1.2 для проверки на суррогате.

Кандидат id=8 (injector_scale=1.2, producer_scale=1.5) показал максимальный прогнозируемый ЧДД (13747.73 млн руб) среди всех протестированных вариантов, превысив предыдущий максимум (id=3, 12505.33 млн руб). Прогноз выполнен на суррогате TimesFM, все ограничения расписания и BHP соблюдены (source_schedule_constraints_checked_before_forecast: true). Ограничения по воде отсутствуют (operating_constraints: []). Следующий шаг — запуск полного симулятора OPM для физической верификации этого режима и расчета официального ЧДД.
